pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.seoDescription: How DigitalExpert collects, uses and protects your personal information and payment screenshots.
pages.content:
Privacy Policy

How DigitalExpert collects, uses and protects your information when you use digitalexpert.pk, contact us or enrol in a course.

Information we collect

We collect only what we need to help you:

  • Your name, email address, phone or WhatsApp number and city when you fill in a form.
  • The course or service you are interested in.
  • Payment screenshots and transaction details you upload when you enrol.
  • Basic usage data, such as pages visited, to improve the website.

How we use your information

  • To reply to your enquiries and quote requests.
  • To process your enrolment, verify your payment and confirm your admission.
  • To send you updates about your batch, classes and certificate.
  • To improve our website, courses and services.

Payment screenshots

Payment screenshots are used only to verify your payment. They are stored in private secure storage, visible exclusively to authorised DigitalExpert staff, and are never made publicly accessible or shared with third parties.

Sharing your information

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with trusted service providers that help us run the website, such as hosting and email delivery, and when required by applicable law.

Keeping your information safe

We use encrypted SSL connections and limit access to administrative staff. No online system is completely risk-free, so contact us straight away if you suspect any unauthorized activity.

How long we keep it

We keep your information for as long as needed for admissions records, accounting, and legal compliance. After that, records are securely archived or deleted.

Your choices

You can ask us to correct or delete your information, or stop receiving updates, by emailing info@digitalexpert.pk or messaging us on WhatsApp at 03124051296.

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.seoDescription: The rules for using our website, enrolling in courses, and ordering digital marketing services.
pages.content:
Terms of Service

The rules for using our website, enrolling in our courses and ordering our services.

Using this website

You agree to use the website lawfully. Please do not misuse our forms, upload harmful or malicious files, or copy our copyrighted content without prior written permission.

Courses and services

Course and service descriptions, fees and packages are shown in Pakistani rupees (PKR) and may change. The fee shown when you enrol or order is the fee that applies to your registration.

Batch start dates and class timings are coordinated and shared on WhatsApp and may be adjusted with advance notice.

Enrolment and admission

Submitting the enrolment form does not confirm your admission.

Your admission is confirmed only after we receive your valid payment screenshot, verify the transaction with our accounts department, and confirm your seat via WhatsApp or email notification.

Student conduct

Students are expected to behave respectfully toward instructors and peers in physical classes and group discussions. We reserve the right to remove any individual who disrupts learning or violates classroom guidelines.

Course content and certificates

Course lectures, recordings, templates, and materials are solely for your personal education. They may not be redistributed, resold, or shared publicly. Certificates are issued upon completing the required curriculum and practical assignments.

Results

We teach practical, market-proven skills and deliver marketing services with utmost care. However, we cannot guarantee specific financial gains, specific income figures, or guaranteed employment outcomes.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The latest version published on this page is the one in effect.

pages.title: Refund Policy
pages.seoDescription: When refunds are possible for training courses and digital marketing service packages.
pages.content:
Refund Policy

When a refund is possible for course fees and service packages. Please read this before making a payment.

Courses

If you request a refund before your batch start date, and within 7 days of payment, we refund the course fee after deducting standard payment transfer charges.

Once classes begin, course fees are non-refundable, as classroom seats and mentor time are reserved in advance. Exceptional cases are evaluated strictly at our discretion.

Service packages

Agency service packages are refundable only before kickoff and before creative or technical work has commenced.

Once design, development, or ad setup has started, the completed portion is non-refundable. We will discuss and reconcile any unused project balance in good faith.

If we cancel

If DigitalExpert cancels a scheduled training batch or is unable to deliver an agreed-upon service, you may choose between a prompt 100% full refund or transferring your balance to a future batch or service.

How to request a refund

  • Message us on WhatsApp at 03124051296 or email info@digitalexpert.pk with your full name, course/service, and payment receipt.
  • We review and respond within 2 working days.
  • Approved refunds are processed to your original payment account within 7 working days.

pages.title: Payment Policy
pages.seoDescription: How to pay for courses and agency services, accepted methods, and verification rules.
pages.content:
Payment Policy

How to pay for a course or service, and how your admission is confirmed.

How to enrol and pay

  • Open the course you want and click Enroll Now.
  • Fill in the enrollment form with your accurate details.
  • Pay the exact course fee via one of our accepted payment options.
  • Upload a clear screenshot or receipt of your transaction. The form cannot be submitted without this screenshot.
  • Our team verifies the payment and issues your admission confirmation on WhatsApp and email.

Accepted payment methods

We accept JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and Direct Bank Transfer. Official account numbers and titles are listed on the enrollment page and provided by our administrative desk.

Admission confirmation

Your admission seat is reserved only upon successful payment verification. Verification is typically completed within 24 hours. If you do not hear back within 24 hours, please message our WhatsApp desk at 03124051296 with your transaction ID.

Service payments

Agency service packages require an upfront milestone deposit as agreed before work begins. Monthly retainer packages are billed and payable at the start of each service cycle.

Currency & receipts

All fees are denominated in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) unless an international invoice is explicitly issued. Always retain your digital receipt until your service or admission is finalized.

pages.title: Cookie Policy
pages.seoDescription: Information regarding cookies and browser storage used on digitalexpert.pk.
pages.content:
Cookie Policy

What small pieces of data our website stores in your browser, and why.

What we store

  • Your name: If you enter your name in our welcome popup, we store it in your browser's local storage so we can greet you personally upon your return.
  • Session preferences: Temporary session cookies to remember filter selections and form states.
  • Security cookies: Encrypted, HTTP-only tokens used exclusively to authenticate admin dashboard sessions.
  • Analytics: Anonymous visit statistics to help us monitor performance and optimize user experience.

Why we use them

These lightweight cookies allow our website to navigate smoothly, protect administrative routes, and ensure fast page loads.

Your control

You can clear cookies or block them at any time in your browser settings. The public website remains fully functional without non-essential cookies.
